text:
Anna: Quick sync — we need an onboarding checklist + launch criteria for the model capability discovery endpoint. Customers keep asking: "supported tools", "streaming", and exact token limits. What should we publish by GA? :thinking:

Kevin: +1. Propose a minimal shape we can commit to for GA (must be stable): supported_tools, streaming (bool), max_input_tokens, max_output_tokens, structured_output (bool), function_calling (enum: supported/preview/none). Also include model_version and last_tested_at.

Liam: Token limits are fuzzy in practice. We should publish conservative limits (guaranteed) and an "observed_max" for typical runs. Also add a note about truncation behavior.

Sasha: Runtime notes: need to ensure routing can respect advertised maxs. If model falls back to a variant (quantized), ability to indicate "compatibility_level" would be helpful (e.g., full, compatible-bare, limited).

Maya: From customers: enterprise wants: per-tenant overrides, private deployment flag, and documented regression SLAs for streaming. Sales also asks for a short matrix that maps "uses" -> recommended model family.

Kevin: Draft endpoint example (minimal):

```json
{
  "model": "redwood-200b",
  "model_version": "2026-02-15",
  "supported_tools": ["json_output","tools","embeddings","rerank"],
  "function_calling": "supported",
  "streaming": true,
  "max_input_tokens": 32768,
  "max_output_tokens": 8192,
  "structured_output": true,
  "structured_schema_refs": ["/schemas/order_response_v1.json"],
  "compatibility_level": "full",
  "notes": "max tokens are conservative guarantees; observed max may be higher depending on runtime config"
}
```

Anna: This is great. For launch criteria, can we agree on the following minimal gating?
- API returns these fields for top 10 models in catalog
- Token guarantees validated by load tests (±0 truncation)
- Documentation + examples for function calling and structured output
- Telemetry: we surface token-usage distribution + truncation rate to Console
- Security: no PII in example schemas and security review done

Kevin: I can own the first two (catalog + load tests).

Liam: I'll own telemetry metrics and the truncation regression alert (need an eval set).

Sasha: Platform will add a compatibility flag in the routing layer and validate per-variant behavior. Also need a canary rollout plan: start with hosted only, then Dedicated, then Private.

Maya: Solutions will prepare customer-facing matrix and a short FAQ explaining why published limits are conservative and how to request higher limits (enterprise).

Anna: Nice. A couple of open questions: do we publish "observed_max_tokens" vs just a note? and do we tag streaming as "low-latency"/"high-throughput"?

Kevin: I prefer a numeric observed_max_tokens (tracked daily) and a simple performance tag: streaming_profile: ["low_latency","high_throughput"] — kept optional.

Liam: Careful: observed_max needs confidence intervals. Maybe publish "p50/p90" for observed_max_output_tokens. That gives customers more signal without overpromising.

Sasha: Agree on the p50/p90 approach. Also include a "last_validated_envs" array to indicate which deploy modes have been exercised (hosted, dedicated, private).

deploy-bot: spec-lint OK — schema passes internal lint checks (CI#8721) :white_check_mark:

Anna: Action items:
- Kevin: implement endpoint + run load tests (due EOW)
- Liam: define eval prompts & telemetry dashboards (due next Wed)
- Sasha: add compatibility field to routing + canary plan (due next Tue)
- Maya: draft customer matrix & FAQ (due EOW)

Kevin: noted. Will post a PR with the OpenAPI fragment and sample responses.

Maya: I'll sync with enterprise AE and add a sample request for private deployments.

Anna: Thanks all — will collect PRs and create a rollout checklist for PM review. :thumbsup:

Kevin: one more tiny ask — can we include a small example of tool capability claims? e.g. {"tools": [{"name":"calendar","schema":"v1","io":"structured"}]}

Liam: That should be in docs, and we should include a tiny E2E test that calls the tool through the model.

Anna: Perfect. Closing this thread and moving action items into the product board. :lock:
